page.description: TrueNAS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: iXsystems' storage operating system, installed from its own ISO and managed from a web interface: ZFS pools, shares, snapshots and apps on x86-64 hardware.
pros: ZFS pools, snapshots and replication built in.
Web interface for storage, shares, users and apps.
Community Edition is free; the enterprise appliances share the code base.
A separate installer ISO, so the OS disk stays independent of the data disks.
cons: ZFS wants RAM and ECC is often recommended.
x86-64 only for the Community Edition installer.
The installer erases the disk it is pointed at.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for TrueNAS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the installer ISO to a USB stick and boot it; the installer installs to the disk you choose and erases that disk. Pools are created afterwards from the web interface.
